actual_request.prompt:
Edit image1 into ONE new complete character frame. Make an independently redrawn STANDING IDLE sprite in the same SOUTHWEST FRONT-LEFT 3/4 direction. Keep nose, chest, pelvis and boots facing diagonally down-left. BOTH complete boots planted FLAT next to one another below hips, neither leg leading or trailing. Weight balanced evenly, relaxed knees, still robe/hair. This must be a new standing drawing, never reuse a walk frame.
Image1 camera/proportions/design edit target; image2 original girl identity; image3 approved primary bright clean painted Daoist chibi style. Redraw the actual leg/ankle articulation and corresponding folds. Preserve identical face, head size, long dark high-bun hair, star crown, forehead star, black-red-ivory-gold ornate costume and full black-gold boots. Anatomical right hand retains original round astrolabe, left hand retains exactly three star cards. Keep all equipment and design details, natural small secondary motion if walking. No added accessories.
Native square >=1024 pixels, one whole character with genuine transparent alpha, no floor/shadow, no checkerboard, no colored edge, no text/UI/panels. Keep whole body within margins and same scale; axis x512 and grounded-boot sole y942 normalized to1024.
